summary: Implemented the Tabs feature in the Textual repo working tree, uncommitted. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges and now yields one Text with click spans appended last; Opacity merges blended color into existing style so click metadata is preserved; _layout_resolve.py gained a concrete LayoutEdge class; docs/reference/tabs.md added; tests added to tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py, tests/renderables/test_opacity.py, and new tests/test_tabs.py. Existing tests unchanged. Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests are unverified. Deviations: bar position uses displayed-tab index rather than find_tab_by_name's full-list index (needed for duplicate names to match acceptance criterion 11); Escape calls app.set_focus(None) un-awaited since the app has no focus method; can_focus=True was added so the widget receives keys; letter search applies only to single-character keys; no sandbox demo was added.
